body.text: Goals: Explain how Snoop went from Long Beach to the world. “How does Snoop sound dangerous but chill at the same time?” That’s the magic.

body.label: Key points
items: Long Beach realities (gang culture, community, the era)
Warren G passing Snoop’s tape to Dre
Why Dre saw Snoop as different
The birth of G-Funk (Parliament/Funkadelic samples + heavy bass + whistles)
Snoop’s voice as Dre’s missing ingredient
